medical.title: Usage Notice
medical.compactBody: Barodori does not replace treatment or diagnosis. It helps caregivers set goals, record exercises instructed by clinicians, and review progress through reports at home.
medical.body: Barodori is a home-care recording tool and does not replace treatment or diagnosis. Exercise methods and intensity should be decided with your clinician or therapist. Records and reports are reference materials for organizing the situation.
medical.emergency: If your child shows pain, intense crying, fever, breathing issues, sudden movement restriction, or neurological symptoms, seek medical attention immediately.
medical.stress: Caregiver condition-check results are for reference only and must not be used for diagnosis or treatment decisions.

seo.title: Baby Head Shape Type Test
seo.description: Which type is your baby? One photo and 30 seconds is all it takes.

intro.title: Which type is our baby?
intro.subtitle: One photo and 30 seconds is all it takes
intro.privacyNote: 🔒 Photos are processed only on your device and never sent anywhere
intro.disclaimerShort: This is a just-for-fun type test

photo.guide: Frame your baby's head as seen from above
photo.permissionBody: No problem. You can use a gallery photo or the questions instead.
photo.alignTitle: Rotate until the nose points up
analyzing: Tracing the back of the head…
Almost there — meet your baby's type!
photo.qualityFailTitle: This photo was hard to judge
photo.qualityFailBody: A retake in bright light, with the head filling the frame, works best.
photo.barelyTitle: A retake following the guide would be more accurate
photo.modelFailTitle: Photo analysis is not available on this device
photo.modelFailBody: The questions find your baby's type in about 30 seconds.

questions.text: Looking down at your baby from above, how does the head shape feel?
From the side, how does the back of the head look?
Facing your baby, how do the ears look?
options: One looks a little more forward

questions.text: When sleeping, which way does the head usually turn?
questions.helper: Choose from your baby's point of view

questions.text: How much of the day does your baby spend lying on their back?
options: Quite a lot of held or tummy-down time too

questions.text: How does your baby take tummy-down playtime?
options: Loves it and holds up well
Gets tired after a little while

result.statsFallback: New {type} friends are gathering one by one.
result.tipsSafety: Play while your baby is awake, with an adult watching nearby.
result.appCtaHead: If today's play was fun, what should we play tomorrow?
result.appCtaSub: In the app, play like this continues step by step, matched to your baby's age.
result.disclaimer: This is a just-for-fun type test. It is not a medical diagnosis or measurement, and the result says nothing about your baby's health.
result.hospital: If you are curious about your baby's head shape, feel free to ask at your next pediatric visit. An accurate check is always best done with a doctor.

share.tail: Which type is your baby? 30 seconds at barodori.com!

hooks.ttaomi: A curious one who sees the world at a tilt 🟣 It's not just our baby, right?
hooks.banguri: Cozy smiley Banguri 💙 No one can resist this smile!
hooks.ppyojogi: The rarely-seen slender Ppyojogi 🌱 Our baby is an uncommon type!
hooks.jjanggu: Confident round-crowned Jjanggu has arrived ✌️ Which type is your baby?
hooks.donggeuri: Certified well-balanced sweetheart 💛 Who could scroll past Donggeuri!

ttaomi.name: Ttaomi
ttaomi.oneLiner: A curious one who sees the world at a gentle tilt
traits: Our Ttaomi tilts that little head because the world is just so interesting.
With a clear favorite side, nothing loved ever escapes those watchful eyes.
A curious one discovering the world from an angle all their own.

under3m.title: Twinkle rattle chase
under3m.body: Gently shake a rattle on the {side} side, the one your baby rarely watches. The new half of the world gets interesting too.

under3m.title: Follow that face
under3m.body: Hold your baby, lock eyes, and drift slowly toward the {side} side together. Mom and dad's face is the best toy there is.

from3m.title: Toy fishing
from3m.body: Place a favorite toy on the {side} side and let those little hands reach. A fun way to practice using the whole body evenly.

from3m.title: Mirror peekaboo
from3m.body: Peekaboo with a mirror on the {side} side! Finding that face in the mirror makes the new direction a fast friend.

banguri.name: Banguri
banguri.oneLiner: A cozy one with a smile as generous as that broad head
traits: Our Banguri has a heart as generous as that broad little head.
Comfortable anywhere in no time, and one smile warms the whole house.
A cozy one who loves mom and dad's faces more than any view in the world.

under3m.title: Chest-time snuggle
under3m.body: Let your baby lie tummy-down on your chest, eyes locked with yours. A few short moments a day is plenty.

under3m.title: Side-by-side chat
under3m.body: Lie on your sides face to face and chat away. A whole new angle on the world.

from3m.title: Airplane whoosh
from3m.body: Tummy-down on your arm, then whoosh! The wide-open view brings giggles tumbling out.

from3m.title: Tummy treasure hunt
from3m.body: Place a toy just ahead during tummy-down play and let those hands reach. Playtime doubles as exercise time.

ppyojogi.name: Ppyojogi
ppyojogi.oneLiner: A slender one with a long, graceful silhouette
traits: Our Ppyojogi charms everyone with that long, graceful silhouette.
Along those long lines, dreams and height both seem ready to shoot up.
A special, slender one you will not easily meet anywhere else.

under3m.title: Lap concert
under3m.body: Lay your baby on your lap face to face and sing. Mom and dad's expressions are the best show in town.

under3m.title: Mobile sightseeing
under3m.body: Move the mobile to a new spot often, so your baby gets an even view of the world from every direction.

from3m.title: Roly-poly rolling
from3m.body: Roll your baby gently across a soft blanket. Every sense wakes up delighted.

from3m.title: House tour in arms
from3m.body: Carry your baby around the house naming everything you see. The slender one's world grows wider.

jjanggu.name: Jjanggu
jjanggu.oneLiner: A confident one proud of that nicely rounded crown
traits: Our Jjanggu is proud of that nicely rounded crown.
A happy mood means both arms shoot straight up — a little hooray fairy.
A confident one, brimming with spirit right up to the top of that head.

under3m.title: Hooray stretch
under3m.body: Hold those little arms gently and stretch them up — hooray! Jjanggu's favorite pose wakes the whole body.

under3m.title: Black-and-white gallery
under3m.body: Show a book with bold contrast. Those confident eyes will sparkle.

from3m.title: Drum it out
from3m.body: Hand over a safe container to bang on. A confident sense of rhythm grows.

from3m.title: Rollover cheer squad
from3m.body: Place a toy to the side and cheer on the rollover. A big round of applause when it lands!

donggeuri.name: Donggeuri
donggeuri.oneLiner: A well-balanced sweetheart, round all around
traits: Our Donggeuri is beautifully balanced, round all around.
Even mid-cry, one shared glance brings back the smile — a soft, easygoing soul.
A sweetheart who has the whole family's laughter all to themselves.

under3m.title: Babble conversations
under3m.body: Answer every coo and babble. Donggeuri loves a back-and-forth chat most of all.

under3m.title: Soft-touch play
under3m.body: Place cloths of different textures in those little hands. Round little fingertips learn the world.

from3m.title: Peekaboo hide-and-seek
from3m.body: Hide behind a handkerchief, then peekaboo! The laughter rolls and rolls.

from3m.title: Clap and pat songs
from3m.body: Play hand-game songs together. Balanced little moves grow stronger every day.
